rv.q: MILLIONS is a heartwarming, beautifully told new musical that explores themes of innocence, generosity, and the moral complexities of sudden wealth.

Alliance Theatre’s latest world premiere musical Millions, running through June 15, comes to Atlanta stacked with a lot of dazzling names attached. But the children onstage enrich the material the most. The pedigree for Millions is unmatched out of the gate.
The show is definitely a work in progress, with potential. But some serious sleeve-rolling is needed.
